text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you went to a hot spring with 
your family last week...! Uh-huh, uh-huh, 
and did you go to the zoo the next day 
too?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It was filled with so many fun things. 
Fufu. Sounds like you had a wonderful day 
off!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I want to hear more about your 
travels. Tell me about the happy moments, 
and what surprised you too!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't worry about it! I want to hear 
it because it's fun for me! After all—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you happy makes me happy too. 
Really, it does! So... I'd love it if you 
kept talking.
